title: AI Search as an Information Intermediary: Clickstream Evidence on Web Traffic
abstract: arXiv:2607.07652v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: AI search retrieves web information to ground generated answers. We study this new information intermediary using U.S. desktop clickstream data observing use alongside referrals during ChatGPT Search's rollout. Referrals accompany 5.4% of ChatGPT sessions versus 31.1% of Google queries. Ad-supported sites receive a smaller share of ChatGPT than Google referrals, while reference and technical sites receive larger shares. Conventional searches (Google, Bing, Yahoo) decline after ChatGPT adoption, sooner when adoption follows ChatGPT Search's expansion to users without accounts. Among existing users, that expansion raises ChatGPT use; conventional searches show no detectable overall change but fall among households with lower prior search activity. These findings suggest AI search can reshape open-web traffic through its own referrals and changes in conventional search.

translated_title: AI搜索作为信息中介：基于点击流数据的网络流量证据
translated_abstract: AI搜索通过检索网络信息来为生成的答案提供依据。本研究利用美国桌面端点击流数据研究这一新型信息中介，观察了ChatGPT Search推广期间的AI搜索使用及其带来的转介流量。ChatGPT会话中仅有5.4%伴随网站转介流量，而Google查询中这一比例为31.1%。与Google相比，广告支持型网站从ChatGPT获得的转介份额更小，而参考类和技术类网站获得的份额更大。在采用ChatGPT之后，传统搜索（Google、Bing、Yahoo）的使用出现下降，且当ChatGPT Search向无需注册账号的用户开放后，这种下降出现得更快。对于已有用户，此次开放提升了ChatGPT的使用量；传统搜索总体上未见显著变化，但在此前搜索活动较少的家庭中有所下降。这些发现表明，AI搜索可以通过自身的转介流量以及对传统搜索行为的改变来重塑开放网络的流量格局。
tldr: 利用美国桌面点击流数据发现，AI搜索带来的网站转介流量远低于传统搜索引擎（5.4% vs 31.1%），且流量分配偏向参考与技术类网站而非广告支持型网站，同时会抑制传统搜索的使用，表明AI搜索正在通过转介和替代效应重塑开放网络的流量格局。
en_tdlr: Using U.S. desktop clickstream data, this study shows that AI search generates far fewer web referrals than Google (5.4% vs. 31.1%) and skews traffic toward reference and technical sites over ad-supported ones, while displacing conventional search—suggesting AI search can reshape open-web traffic through both its own referrals and reduced traditional search.
